name: AT-meters-kept-nowhere
old: _meterOf(ws) { let m = this._meters.get(ws); if (!m) this._meters.set(ws, m = {}); return m; }
note: A2 verbatim: a meter that is stored nowhere never advances, so every gate passes every frame and nothing is struck.

name: AT-strikes-never-forgiven
note: Strikes accumulate for the life of the socket, so an honest player's rare drops add up to a close.

name: AT-strike-bound-off-by-one
note: One frame past every arm's strike bound.

name: AT-junk-never-counts-up
note: A stream of junk is never struck out.

name: AT-pose-write-skipped
note: The pose, its turn and its keepalive stamp are never written: a wake (and the range gate) reads a stale pose.

name: AT-a-meter-back-on-the-attachment
note: A1 verbatim: a meter written onto the 2 KiB attachment again - the closed field list refuses it.

name: AT-meters-outlive-a-wake
old: this._meters = new WeakMap();   // ws -> its meters (_meterOf)
new: this._meters = (globalThis.__roomMeters ??= new WeakMap());   // ws -> its meters (_meterOf)
note: Meters kept across a wake: the design says a wake forgets them, and the pin says so.

name: AT-park-strikes-on-the-party-meter
note: Main's HCC-PARK meter as it merged: the park frame's strikes on the party pose meter's `pdrops`, so either meter's pass forgave the other's flood.
